script_text: Listen! Mars is aggressively squaring your Venus-ruled heart this week, dear Libra, and the cosmic tension is impossible to ignore. You're caught between your natural desire for peace and an unfamiliar urge to finally speak your unfiltered truth. This friction peaks around February 10th when the Moon enters your opposite sign of Aries, illuminating your relationship sector. But here's what the ancient star maps reveal: this discomfort isn't a warning—it's an initiation. Partnerships built on pretense will crack; authentic connections will crystallize. Your legendary diplomacy isn't abandoning you—it's evolving into something more honest. By February 13th, Mercury's trine to Jupiter delivers the clarity you've been desperately seeking. The cosmos demands one thing: What do YOU actually desire? Not what keeps everyone comfortable. Journal before dawn. Carry rose quartz. Your ancestors are whispering—finally listen.
title: Libra Weekly Reading: Mars Square Venus
